stdout:
List comment threads. Use this tool to list comment threads.

Usage:
  yutu commentThread list [flags]

Examples:
# List comment threads on a video
yutu commentThread list --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --maxResults 10
# Search comment threads by terms
yutu commentThread list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --searchTerms 'hello'
# List specific comment threads in JSON format
yutu commentThread list --ids abc123,def456 --output json

Flags:
  -a, --allThreadsRelatedToChannelId string   Returns the comment threads of all videos of the channel and the channel comments as well
  -c, --channelId string                      Channel id of the video owner
  -h, --help                                  help for list
  -i, --ids strings                           IDs of the comment threads
  -n, --maxResults int                        The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -m, --moderationStatus string               published|heldForReview|likelySpam|rejected (default "published")
  -O, --order string                          orderUnspecified|time|relevance (default "time")
  -o, --output string                         json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                         Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
  -s, --searchTerms string                    Search terms
  -t, --textFormat string                     textFormatUnspecified|html (default "html")
  -v, --videoId string                        Returns the comment threads of the specified video
